english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the time the sun comes up and the sunrise scene, including its colors.
Use this when you mean the exact event or time of the sun coming up rather than the surrounding dawn period.

examples.english: We went to the mountaintop to watch the sunrise.
examples.traditional: 我哋朝早去山頂睇日出。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 saan1 deng2 tai2 jat6 ceot1

examples.english: At dawn, the whole sea turned golden.
examples.traditional: 日出嗰陣，成個海面都變金色。
examples.jyutping: jat6 ceot1 go2 zan6 seng4 go3 hoi2 min6 dou1 bin3 gam1 sik1
